name: Parker's Lunch
summary: Darcy packs Parker's Lunch in Lakeshire for Guard Parker's patrol. The meal offers a glimpse of the bonds and modest comforts among Redridge's defenders.

sections.title: A Meal for the Road
sections.body: Darcy, a waitress at the Lakeshire inn, packs a meal for Guard Parker. He patrols the exposed road south toward Duskwood while Redridge faces attacks from gnolls and Blackrock orcs. The garrison is stretched thin and cut off from Stormwind's aid, leaving guards to keep long, lonely watches. Darcy's small gesture keeps Parker fed and begins a bashful courtship between the two townspeople.

faq.answer: Darcy, a waitress at the Lakeshire inn, prepares Parker's Lunch for Guard Parker, who is out on patrol. A traveler carries it to him.

faq.q: Where can Guard Parker be found?
faq.answer: Guard Parker patrols the main dirt road southwest from Lakeshire toward the Duskwood border. He marches back and forth, watching for roaming gnolls.

faq.q: What does Guard Parker do after receiving his lunch?
faq.answer: Parker is touched by Darcy's thoughtfulness and seeks a way to return her kindness. He arranges to send her fresh daffodils from the herbalist.

faq.q: Why doesn't Darcy deliver the lunch herself?
faq.answer: Gnolls and Blackrock invaders threaten the roads outside Lakeshire. Darcy is an ordinary towns-person, while Parker has the training and armor to patrol them.

angles.text: For frontier guards, a warm packed meal can be a comfort through long hours in the wilderness among hostile beasts.
With reinforcements from the capital slow to arrive, townspeople and the few remaining guards support one another to keep Lakeshire functioning.
